title: Righteousness of Christ
definition: The righteousness of Christ is His perfect conformity to God's will and the righteousness credited to believers through faith.
summary: Jesus is perfectly righteous, and His righteousness is the believer's hope before God.
christFocus: Christ provides the righteousness sinners lack and need in order to stand accepted before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christ's righteousness includes His perfect obedience, holy character, and full conformity to the Father's will. He is righteous in every way.

Believers are not accepted before God because of their own righteousness. They are justified through faith in Christ, receiving righteousness in Him.

This doctrine gives deep assurance. The believer's standing rests on Christ's righteousness, not fluctuating feelings or imperfect performance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people live under guilt because they are trying to build their own righteousness. The righteousness of Christ matters because it directs hope away from self and toward the Savior.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop trying to make yourself acceptable by your own record. Trust Christ's righteousness, and let gratitude lead you into righteous living.
